headline: R1_RT_MECHANISM_PROVED_ANSWERS_WITHHELD
claim_status_basis: The mechanism is built and every part of it is measured. No claim is made about the brain's performance on the runtime's task, because the runtime declined to authorise the answers and no exam was run. The status words are the spec sheet's own legend.

what_was_established.evidence: appendix F section 2: one missing leg drives the best yield to zero, so the brain's own gate G2 refuses on EVERY case with a missing leg
appendix F section 8, the spare-constant encoding. Proved against the runtime's LIVE oracle; figures below

what_was_established.part: the patch that lets an operation see the task's content
what_was_established.evidence: appendix D, measured on the runtime's own method

what_was_established.part: a client operation the runtime accepts and calls
the brain behind that client, across a process boundary
what_was_established.evidence: appendix I: 3 of 3 ticks, three distinct answers, read by the runtime's own decoder

what_was_established.part: surviving a restart through HELM's own store
what_was_established.evidence: appendix J: create, tick, close, reopen, tick, both answers correct on different cases

what_was_established.part: a real nested repair inside HELM driven by the brain
what_was_established.evidence: appendix K: the verifier ABSTAINS with reason EXPERIMENTAL_OPERATION_NOT_AUTHORITY_ADMITTED, and the only door into a repair frame requires a REPAIR receipt

falsifications_caught_by_measurement: the brain and HELM's runtime cannot share a process (appendix E): all four import orders refused
the frozen input rule cannot name a failing leg (appendix F): the brain's own gate refuses, ceiling 36 of 288
a client operation can never be believed by the verifier (appendix K): it abstains before the semantic comparison

process_boundary_cost_per_tick_ms.note: measured, recorded in the appendix, not re-measured here

client_patch_cost.note: route D's edits were the design's one edit. The client adds the rest, and every one of them was forced by a measured refusal or a measured failure.

NOT_CLAIMED: that the recipe brain can answer the runtime's task, or any mark on it. No exam was run.
that anything was published or authorised inside HELM. The runtime abstained and the receipt says audit_only: True.
that wave 1's reading is altered, upgraded or superseded. It is untouched.
that a nested repair was driven. It is unreachable as designed.
that the design's own decoder contract is the task's. native_task.task_decoder_contracts pins ^6, so a client run bypasses it, and no version-2 contract with its lineage exists yet.
that the envelope is re-costed. It is not.
any claim about generality. The brain's own record says it is task-specific.
what_the_claim_actually_is: The same answers COMPUTED INSIDE HELM's runtime, decoded by its own decoder, and WITHHELD by its own verifier.
owner_authority: The owner authorised the engineering on copies and no more. Nothing has been applied to a frozen tree, no paid run is authorised, and the one decision this result puts to the owner - whether to declare the client operation authority-admitted - is open and is not assumed here.
